tasks.name: validate-json-valid
tasks.run: cargo run --quiet --locked -- validate sykli.json --json | jq -e '.schema == "sykli-validate.v1" and .valid == true and (.contract_hash | length) == 64' >/dev/null

tasks.name: validate-json-invalid
tasks.run: printf '{"schema":"sykli-contract.v1","tasks":[{"name":"a","run":"true","after":["missing"]}]}' > "$TMPDIR/bad-contract.json"; code=0; out=$(cargo run --quiet --locked -- validate "$TMPDIR/bad-contract.json" --json) || code=$?; test "$code" -eq 1 && echo "$out" | jq -e '.valid == false and (.errors | length) > 0' >/dev/null
